objective: Qualify configured ratios, role-eligible shared staff and a named static team/space reservation approximation; preserve breaks, bounded overtime, call-in readiness, handover and escort continuity. No upstream atomic-grant claim.
interface_contract: B4.1–B4.3 and qualified core StaffingRegistry; B3 SpacePool. Static bounded single-process reservations, not a queued shared-resource scheduler.
steps: Add failing configured-ratio/shared-team/role-matching/absence/break/overtime/call-in/handover/escort and composite rollback controls.
Implement deterministic role matching over qualified core staffing, plus clone/validate/commit static space/team admission; preserve in-memory replay and role eligibility on handover/escort.
Run focused B4, existing corestaffing and all-target clippy; independent review and scoped current-head native verification before acceptance.

verification.oracle: Configured ratio/role matching, whole-interval availability, rollback, handover and escort behavior pass.
Qualified core staffing contract remains passing.

acceptance: Ratios/role names/cohort units are versioned input, never universal clinical defaults.
Each staff member fills only one concurrent role; feasible flexible-role matching cannot be rejected by greedy assignment.
Break/absence/roster/overtime/call-in bounds apply to whole duty intervals.
Failed team/space admission leaves both registries unchanged.
Handover has explicit overlap and contiguous continuation; escorts retain the same worker and no unsafe active procedure interruption is admitted.
size_exception: Seven exact paths include module declaration, team implementation, readonly space eligibility accessor, one behavior target, evidence, packet and mandatory inventory; coordinator reviewed bounded scope.
